[...] Assistant: I’m adding one ignored public-relay scenario as evidence, separate from CI: source list and Bob’s kind:10002 go to relay A, Bob’s note goes only to relay B, and the app is configured with relay A only. A PASS means the kernel learned B from NIP-65 and fetched the materialized author row there; a SKIP stays honest if public relays don’t cooperate.
